rows.notes: The cited document is a narrative review (titled 'Review'; abstract states 'This review explores...'; Data Availability: Not applicable). It reports no own data, experiment, survey or model runs. Section 3.4.1 only summarises other studies on AI-driven irrigation management (e.g. Italy 20% water reduction [66], SIMDualKc in Portugal [68]) and does not report any own result on irrigation DSS delivering regulated deficit irrigation or grape quality.

Narrative review with no primary data. Statements about data-driven irrigation scheduling saving water (Behzadipour et al. 11% saving in Section 2.3.2; Italian vineyard 20% reduction in Section 3.4.1) are secondary citations of other work, not the study's own result. No variable-rate application result reported.

Narrative review; Section 3.2 summarises UAV multispectral/hyperspectral disease detection studies (Albetis et al., di Gennaro, Junges, MacDonald, V<U+00E9>lez) and a reported 40% pesticide reduction at a Spanish vineyard [52], all cited from other work. The review itself presents no own evidence that remote sensing improves timing/precision of plant protection.

Narrative review with no primary data. No own result on remote sensing reducing unnecessary applications or protecting grape integrity/quality; relevant statements in Sections 3.1-3.2 are assertions or summaries of cited studies.
